text:
oliver_partnerships: Quick sync thread  partners want a single source of truth for embargo windows + cert status for H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi before marketplace freeze. Who has final artifact timelines?

ash_vendor_pm: H200 BIOS candidate will be tagged `h200-bios-2024-04-12` and uploaded to the partner bucket. ETA: 2024-04-12T18:00:00Z. S3: s3://partners/redwood/h200/h200-bios-2024-04-12.bin sha256: `3b7f9c1a2d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a`

tom_infra: B200 run yesterday showed a ~6% perf drop under our default power profile. I will re-run with `b200-fan-v3` Tue 06:00 UTC and push a new image tag `b200-fanv3-2024`. Also Gaudi needs kernel 6.1 backport; I'm building `gaudi-k6-backport-2024` image tonight.

nina_si: SI availability: Wed/Thu 07:00-10:00 UTC open for full connector+interop. We need final BIOS, driver, and kernel packages by Tue EOD to meet the Friday freeze. If artifacts land late we can only certify H100 baseline and B200 partial (power-profile dependent).

rachel_comms: Partner press constraint: vendor requests 48h embargo notice before any public announcement. Recommend we avoid listing H200/MI300/Gaudi in marketplace copy until SI certs are green. Draft blurb suggestion below.

oliver_partnerships: I propose a conservative freeze plan: publish H100 GA + B200 (if SI-green after fanv3). Mark H200/MI300/Gaudi as "under validation" with an expected follow-on GA window. Contingency flow: if H200 BIOS misses Tue EOD, fallback to H100-only landing and schedule a joint patch release announcement when H200 is green.

```
Quick test matrix (snapshot):
H100: PASS (images v1.3)
B200: PERF delta (~6%) -> rerun with `b200-fan-v3`
H200: BIOS candidate pending (h200-bios-2024-04-12)
MI300: 32k context OOM observed on quant path (debug nightly)
Gaudi: kernel mismatch -> `gaudi-k6-backport-2024` image in build
```

deploy-bot: images queued: `gaudi-k6-backport-2024` -> staging 2024-04-11T23:30:00Z, `b200-fanv3-2024` -> staging 2024-04-12T06:10:00Z. Will post smoke results.

ash_vendor_pm: Uploaded H200 BIOS to s3://partners/redwood/h200/1742109876/ and pasted sha above. No embargo exceptions from vendor side beyond 48h. Also sharing recommended B200 fan-profile: s3://partners/redwood/b200/b200-fan-v3.conf

tom_infra: Reruns booked Tue 06:00-09:00 UTC. I will post perf diffs and the `perf_summary.csv` after runs. If B200 still >5% perf hit with v3, we will flag in marketplace as "certified with performance caveat" and include recommended runtime config for customers.

nina_si: SI will run full cert Wed 07:00 UTC if artifacts present. If anything arrives late we run a focused connector smoke for H100+B200 and postpone H200/MI300/Gaudi full cert by 7 days. Please paste any S3 links + sha256s here so SI can pull artifacts.

rachel_comms: Draft blurb (internal only): "Initial GA: H100 (certified). B200: certification in progress; shipping with recommended runtime profile if SI-green. H200, MI300, and Gaudi: under validation; will be added to marketplace after partner-driven SI certification and vendor embargo window closure." Will not publish until SI confirms green and vendor embargo window observed.

oliver_partnerships: Action items recap: (1) Ash to confirm BIOS upload & sha (done), (2) Tom to post perf diffs + perf_summary.csv after Tue run, (3) Nina to confirm SI run results Wed AM, (4) Rachel to hold marketplace copy until SI green + 48h embargo cleared. Keep this thread as canonical. Paste all artifact URIs and hashes here. :lock_with_key:
